launcher.title: Choose an app
launcher.subtitle: Four apps, one shared set of demo data. Open them in separate tabs to watch changes flow between them.

customer.name: Customer Portal
customer.description: B2B shippers get quotes, book and track shipments, and manage invoices.

partnerPortal.name: Partner Portal
partnerPortal.description: Delivery partner offices accept jobs, assign staff and track payouts.

partnerApp.name: Partner App
partnerApp.description: Riders, drivers and hub staff run pickups, trips and deliveries on the phone.

erp.name: Logisco ERP + Control Tower
erp.description: Logisco staff watch the network, handle exceptions and run finance.

personas.title: Who are you today?
personas.subtitle: Pick a demo persona. Each one sees the menus and data their role allows.

login.title: Log in as {{name}}
login.wrongOtp: That OTP is not right. Check it and try again.

header.notificationsSoon: Notifications arrive in a later phase.

search.label: Search
search.comingSoon: Search arrives with the shipment screens in Phase 2.

placeholder.customer: Search LR, invoice, PO or consignee
placeholder.partner: Search job, LR, trip, staff or vehicle
placeholder.erp: Search LR, customer, partner, invoice, claim…

search.many: {{count}} shipments match. Type more of the LR.

placeholder.title: This screen is not built yet
placeholder.body: It is part of the build plan.
placeholder.bodyPhase: It arrives in Phase {{phase}} of the build plan.

access.deniedTitle: You don’t have access to this page
access.deniedBody: This screen isn’t available for your role or account type. Ask your admin if you need it.
access.notFoundBody: Check the address, or use the menu to find your way.

pa.offlineBanner: You are offline. Work is saved and will sync.

toolbar.title: Demo controls
toolbar.resetBody: All four apps go back to the seed data and the clock returns to Mon 23-Nov 10:00. Bookings and actions made in the demo are lost. Logins stay.

cp11.title: Dashboard

banner.walletLow: Your wallet balance is low. Recharge to keep booking.
banner.creditHigh: You have used more than 80% of your credit limit.
banner.invoiceOverdue: You have an overdue invoice. Bookings may be put on hold.
banner.pilot: Your account is in its pilot period. Your account manager is watching every shipment.

cp11.slaNone: No shipments were due in this period.
cp11.slaDetail: {{onTime}} of {{due}} due shipments delivered on time
cp11.noActions: Nothing needs your action right now

action.ndr: Failed delivery: choose what to do
action.claim: Short or damaged: raise a claim

cp12.title: Get quote
cp12.subtitle: All-in price and delivery date before you book. Nothing is added later except a weight revision verified at pickup.
cp12.codTooHigh: COD amount cannot be more than the goods value.
cp12.fillIn: Fill in the route, packages and goods value to see the price.

error.unknownPincode: We don’t serve this pincode yet.
error.originNotServiceable: We don’t pick up from this pincode yet.
error.destNotServiceable: We don’t serve this pincode yet.
error.noLane: PTL isn’t offered on this route. Try Parcel.
error.serviceNotOnLane: This service isn’t on your rate card for this route.

cp12.ewbNote: An e-way bill will be generated automatically (valid {{days}} days).
cp12.notServed: We don’t serve this pincode yet.

cp13.title: Book shipment
cp13.subtitle: Six short steps. Each step is checked before you move on.
cp13.noPartner: No partner can take the {{leg}} leg right now. Try another date or contact support.
cp13.bookingFailed: The booking could not be created. Please try again.
cp13.cutoffHint: Same-day pickup only if booked before {{cutoff}}
cp13.noSlots: No slots left on this date
cp13.mobileHint: Used for the delivery OTP and WhatsApp updates
cp13.gstinHint: Used on the e-way bill for B2B
cp13.totalsPending: Add the consignee pincode and package sizes to see the weights.
cp13.invoiceCopyHint: PDF or image, up to 5 MB
cp13.fileTooBig: That file is larger than 5 MB.
cp13.ewbRequired: An e-way bill is needed for this shipment (valid {{days}} days).
cp13.ewbNotRequired: No e-way bill is needed for this shipment.
cp13.appointmentNote: The consignee confirms the appointment slot from the tracking link.

block.walletLow: Your wallet balance doesn’t cover this booking.
block.creditExceeded: This booking would exceed your available credit. Please contact your Finance team.
block.invoiceOverdue: An invoice is overdue beyond the grace period. Please contact your Finance team.
block.codTooHigh: The COD amount is more than the invoice value.
block.hsnRequired: An HSN code is needed for the e-way bill.
block.invoiceDateFuture: The invoice date can’t be in the future.

err.notServiceable: We don’t serve this pincode yet.
err.gstin: A GSTIN has 15 letters and digits.
err.rows: Fill in quantity, size and weight for every package row.
err.futureDate: The invoice date can’t be in the future.
err.hsn: An HSN code has 4 to 8 digits.
err.hsnRequired: An HSN code is needed for the e-way bill.
err.ewbNo: An e-way bill number has 12 digits.
err.codTooHigh: COD amount cannot be more than the invoice value.
err.tbbCreditOnly: TBB is for credit customers only.

cp14.title: Booking confirmed
cp14.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the number instead.
cp14.appointmentPending: Appointment slot to be confirmed by the consignee

erp05.title: Live job board
erp05.emptyBody: Try another filter, or include finished work.
erp05.mapNote: {{count}} shipments on the map. Click a dot to open its Shipment 360.

erp03.mapNote: Position estimated from status and leg times until live GPS is connected.
erp03.belowTarget: Below the {{pct}}% target: flagged in the margin monitor
erp03.noClaims: No tickets or claims on this shipment

erpActions.extendBody: E-way bill {{no}} is valid till {{date}}. Logisco will request an extension from the NIC portal.
erpActions.partBBody: Send the vehicle details for this movement to the NIC portal.
erpActions.messageVia: Sent by WhatsApp and email to the customer’s contacts.

delay.name: Delay notice
delay.body: Shipment {{lr}} is running behind schedule. We are working to deliver it by {{eta}} and will update you shortly.

pickupReschedule.name: Pickup rescheduled
pickupReschedule.body: The pickup for {{lr}} has been rescheduled. Our partner will contact your pickup contact with the new time.

appointment.name: Appointment reminder
appointment.body: Shipment {{lr}} is due on {{eta}}. Please ask the consignee to confirm the delivery appointment from the tracking link.

erpActions.callBody: The call goes through a masked number, so neither side sees the other’s phone number.

flag.title: Flag {{job}} as not serviceable
flag.body: The job goes back to Logisco to be offered to another partner. Flags count towards your Responsiveness score.

problem.title: Report a problem on {{job}}
problem.body: Logisco’s Control Tower sees this as a ticket on the shipment.
problem.done: Problem reported. A ticket has been raised.

alert.claim: Claim {{claim}} on {{lr}} is attributed to you

tierCap.bronze: Bronze tier: capped at your declared capacity

pp12.title: Job inbox
pp12.subtitle: Jobs Logisco has given {{partner}}. Accept or flag each one.
pp12.selectAll: Select all jobs on this page

pp14.title: Assign to field staff
pp14.subtitle: The staff member gets the job in the Partner App straight away.
pp14.nothingBody: Only accepted or assigned jobs of your company can be assigned.
pp14.vehicleRule: Needed for pickups over 30 kg and for line-haul

err.vehicle: Choose a vehicle for this job.
err.mixed: Pick jobs of one type at a time (for example, only pickups).

block.policeVerificationPending: Police verification pending: can’t be assigned

scanner.pointCamera: Point the camera at a label

pa07.title: Scan
pa07.body: Scan any label. The app opens the task it belongs to.

pa14.arrivedOk: Location checked: you are at the pickup point
pa14.geofence: Location must be within {{m}} m of the pin

pa15.ewbMatches: The e-way bill number on the papers matches
pa15.cannotLater: Can’t pick up, or a piece is missing? That flow arrives in Phase 4.

todo.scan: Scan all pieces and take the invoice photo to continue
todo.weigh: Enter the weight and take the scale photo to continue
todo.confirm: Get the shipper’s signature or OTP to confirm

pa16.revision: The customer will be asked to accept the new weight: + {{amount}}

pa17.liability: From now on your company is responsible for these goods.
pa17.revisionSent: Weight revision of + {{amount}} sent to the customer

pa19.title: Hand over
pa19.receiverMissing: No one at {{partner}} is assigned to receive yet.
pa19.todo: Scan every piece and take the photo
pa19.codeHelp: Let {{name}} scan this code, or read it out.
pa19.liability: The goods stay your responsibility until the receiver confirms.
pa19.doneLiability: Responsibility for the goods is now with {{partner}}.

pa20.title: Receive hand-over
pa20.waitingGiver: Waiting for {{name}} to show the hand-over code.
pa20.noCodeYet: {{name}} has not shown a code yet.
pa20.problems: This will be accepted with an exception
pa20.hold: The goods go on hold and {{partner}} must investigate within {{hours}} hours.

todo.code: Enter or scan the hand-over code
todo.count: Scan every piece, or mark the count finished

pa20.doneException: Accepted with exception. A ticket is raised for {{partner}}.

pa26.title: Inbound
pa26.empty: Nothing to in-scan. Loads you receive from riders and trucks appear here.
pa26.excessHint: A label that is not on this load is an excess: keep it aside.
pa26.reweigh: Re-weigh this load on the hub scale
pa26.weightDiffers: Differs from the pickup weight by {{kg}}. It is noted on the in-scan.

todo.weight: Enter the hub weight and take the scale photo

pa27.title: Sort to bag
pa27.wrongBag: Wrong bag: this is {{scanned}}. Put it in {{bag}}.

pa28.title: Bags
pa28.noOpen: No open bags. Sorting a piece opens one.
pa28.newNoTrip: No truck planned yet for this destination
pa28.todo: Enter the seal and take the photo

pa29.title: Outbound
pa29.empty: No sealed bags waiting to go.
pa29.lateCutoff: Leaving after the {{time}} cut-off: the delivery date is at risk.
pa29.vehicleMismatch: Not the truck for this trip ({{reg}})
pa29.todo: Confirm the truck, scan every bag, seal the door and take the photo

pa20m.waitingHub: Waiting for {{hub}} to load the truck and show the code.
pa20m.notLoaded: {{hub}} is still sorting and sealing. The hand-over opens here when they load your truck.
pa20m.todoCount: Scan every bag, or mark the count finished
